profile_text.body:
Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company Limited describes itself as the world's dedicated semiconductor foundry since 1987. According to its site, it supports an ecosystem of global customers and partners with process technology and a portfolio of design enablement solutions, which it says unleashes innovation for the global semiconductor industry. The company also describes its business model as accelerating innovation in integrated circuit (IC) design and product applications, and states that it contributes to global IC innovation and to Taiwan's economy.

The company is a public company headquartered in Hsinchu, traded under the ticker TSM, and also listed under the alias TAIWAN SEMICONDUCTOR-SP ADR. Its SEC Central Index Key is 0001046179. No AI products, MCP servers, or lawsuits appear in the available records.
